digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and agent banking enforcement
propositions: Dense completion-verifier runs exhaust bounded request budgets with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts due to concurrent tool-batch execution defeating prompt-only serialization
Pydantic AI concurrent tool execution allows model to defer all record_criterion_verdict calls until after budget exhaustion, violating the incremental banking contract

A completion-only policy wrapper at the build_agent_kwargs seam must atomically serialize one governed repository action per response and invoke fallback met=false record on the third evidence response if still unbanked
The policy enforces a finite state machine: process manifest ids in order, count unique evidence responses per unbanked id, auto-bank after three repository calls, and advance to next id
The wrapped policy must compose between existing memo and runaway-guard layers using a shared lock and live per-criterion boundary tracking to guarantee progress before exhaustion
